headlines.title: Scott Colom blasts Democrats for not investing more in Mississippi
headlines.description: Mississippi U.S. Senate candidate Scott Colom (D) says Democrats did not do enough to be competitive in the state as the Senate race remains too close to call. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor joins Meet the Press NOW with more from her interview.

headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after commission’s approval
headlines.description: The Trump administration has said it expects to begin construction immediately, but a judge is considering a plan to temporarily halt the project.

headlines.title: Hegseth defiant amid impeachment threat
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth put out a new video amid a potential impeachment battle. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Head of DOJ Civil Rights Division resigns after GOP midterms loss
headlines.description: Harmeet Dhillon oversaw a massive overhaul of the Justice Department’s Civil Rights Division, targeting universities and focusing on culture war issues.

headlines.title: Brands lean into human creativity as handcrafted art becomes more of a luxury in the age of AI
headlines.description: Artists say brands are embracing traditional art forms and making a point to show off the human labor behind their campaigns.

headlines.title: Wisconsin reports its first measles death in decades, the third in the U.S. this week
headlines.description: The infant’s death followed a measles-associated death reported Wednesday in Pennsylvania and another Monday in New York.

headlines.title: California Governor commutes all death sentences
headlines.description: Governor Gavin Newsom issued the broadest commutation of death sentences in modern American history. In an open letter, Newsom said he’ll reduce every death sentence in the state to life without the possibility of parole. NBC News’ Laura Jarrett has more on what happens next.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: Affording America: The rising costs of family farming
headlines.description: Javier Zamora achieved his dream of starting his own family farm and watching his customer base grow, but as the costs of labor, chemicals, and diesel have risen, his profit margins have continued to fall.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth strikes defiant tone in face of impeachment threat
headlines.description: Many lawmakers, including some Republicans, have criticized the defense secretary over his handling of the Iran war.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton estate files to dismiss lawsuit against her nephew
headlines.description: The company that manages Parton’s estate had accused her nephew of threatening to destroy her brand.

headlines.title: Trump focuses on White House decor for second straight day in post-midterm remarks
headlines.description: The president signed a proclamation that he said would prevent major changes to the Oval Office and the Cabinet Room by future presidents without congressional approval.
